script_text:
Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now.
Venus, your ruling planet, is forming a precise trine to Saturn in your 7th House, turning love's ambitions into solid, dependable partnerships. Mercury is squaring Pluto in your 2nd House, urging you to investigate finances and avoid impulsive spending.
If you are single, this Venus‑Saturn trine draws a sincere, mature partner into your orbit, while those coupled should listen to the hidden worries the Mercurian tension surfaces.
Your 10th House enjoys a powerful sextile between Jupiter and Mars, delivering a sudden promotion that rewards your steady work ethic. The Mercury‑Pluto clash in your 2nd House warns you to double‑check receipts and curb any costly missteps today.
Skip any speculative trades now, or you’ll squander the breakthrough the planets have granted you, Taurus – keep your Earth element steady.
Follow for tomorrow’s reading so you never miss the next cosmic clue.
